Órgãos sem unidade orçamentária própria: Bodies without their own budget unit (secretariats, councils, most collegiate bodies) have no circle. Neither do state-owned companies that do not depend on the Treasury, such as Caixa, Banco do Brasil and Petrobras: they appear only in the investment budget (CF, art. 165, § 5º, II), which this dataset does not include. Financial charges, civil retirement pensions, transfers to states and municipalities, credit operations and the debt appear separately, in the Money tab.
Fonte: Tesouro Nacional, Despesas e Tran: Source: National Treasury, Despesas e Transferências Totais da União.
Competências que a Constituição dá à Uni: Competences that the Constitution gives to the Union, the states and the municipalities. The Federal District legislates on what falls to states and municipalities (art. 32, § 1º) and appears alongside the states in common and concurrent competences (arts. 23 and 24).
Who may create each tax (arts. 145 to 156-B and 195). The Federal District has the taxes of both states and municipalities (arts. 147 and 155).

Cada barra é uma relação \"repassa recur: Each bar is a "transfers funds to" relationship on the map. Transfers to states and municipalities come largely from the resources supervised by the Ministry of Finance.
Ministérios incluem as entidades vincula: Ministries include the entities linked to them (Anvisa is counted in the Ministry of Health and also appears on its own). Bodies without their own budget unit, such as the Presidency's secretariats, are not shown. Nor are state-owned companies that do not depend on the Treasury (Caixa, Banco do Brasil, Petrobras): they appear only in the investment budget (CF, art. 165, § 5º, II), which this dataset does not include.
Funds with their own budget unit. What they pay is already counted in the ministry they belong to.
Na lei orçamentária, encargos financeiro: In the budget law, the Union's financial charges (including court judgments), civil retirement pensions, transfers to states, the Federal District and municipalities (including the Federal District Constitutional Fund), official credit operations and debt refinancing are bodies of their own, supervised by a ministry. They are left out of the ministry's figure so that the Ministry of Finance does not seem to spend trillions on itself. Debt refinancing (rollover) alone exceeds R$ 2 trillion.

Constituição, leis e decretos no Planalt: Constitution, laws and decrees from the Planalto website; rules of procedure from the websites of the Chamber, the Senate, Congress and the courts; office holders from the Official Gazette and official pages; figures from the National Treasury. The texts are written by us, kept short, without copying protected works.
A pesquisa foi feita por agentes de IA e: The research was done by AI agents in tasks with a log, each reviewed by another agent, and coordinated by an agent that records the scope decisions.
